tushy: Phoebe said her cat liked to sit on its tushy all day and never move.
tusk: Ross explained that a tusk is basically a big tooth, and Joey found that fascinating.

twirl: Rachel did a little twirl in her new dress and asked everyone how she looked.
twitch: Joey got a nervous twitch before auditions and could never get it to stop.
typographic: Ross admired the typographic detail on an old museum sign and told everyone about it.

unholy: Chandler called the state of Joey's fridge an unholy mess and slammed the door.

upfront: Chandler appreciated that Monica was upfront about her rules before the party started.
uphold: Ross promised to uphold the museum's strict rules, then broke one within the hour.
upriver: Ross wanted to travel upriver to look at rock formations, which no one else wanted to do.
upstream: Ross explained swimming upstream, and Joey said it sounded exhausting.
urban: Rachel loved the urban energy of the city, especially the fashion district.
utilising: Monica insisted on utilising every single ingredient in the fridge before shopping again.
utter: Chandler looked at the mess in utter disbelief after Joey tried to cook.
vague: Chandler was vague about his weekend plans, so everyone assumed he had a secret date.
valve: Ross explained how a valve works, and Joey asked if that was a kind of door.
vamoose: Monica told Joey to vamoose from her kitchen before he broke something else.
vanity: Chandler accused Ross of pure vanity for talking about his museum work for an hour.
vapor: Phoebe said she saw her breath turn to vapor in the cold and wrote a song about it.

vegetation: Ross explained the vegetation in a dinosaur's habitat, and Joey lost interest instantly.
vengeance: Chandler swore vengeance on whoever ate his leftovers, and it was obviously Joey.
venom: Ross explained that some snakes have venom, and Joey quickly backed away from the topic.
ventriloquist: Joey tried to be a ventriloquist and his lips moved the whole time.
versatile: Joey claimed he was a versatile actor, though he'd only ever played one type of role.
veteran: Chandler called himself a veteran of the couch, having napped there for years.
viciously: Monica viciously scrubbed the counter until it shined like new.
vindicate: Ross felt vindicated when his dinosaur theory turned out to be completely right.
vine: Phoebe had a vine growing up her wall that she swore sang to her at night.
violet: Rachel wore a violet dress to the fashion event and looked absolutely stunning.
viper: Ross explained what a viper is, and Joey quickly changed the subject to something safer.
vista: Phoebe said the vista from her window was beautiful, then wrote a song about it.
vitality: Monica showed endless vitality, cleaning the whole apartment before anyone else woke up.
voila: Monica whipped the cover off her dessert and said voila, and everyone applauded.
voluminous: Rachel said her hair looked voluminous after a trip to the salon, and she loved it.
vortex: Chandler said the group's drama was a vortex that sucked everyone in every single week.
voucher: Joey found an old voucher in his pocket and used it for a free sandwich.
vulgar: Chandler made a vulgar joke at dinner and Monica threw a napkin at him.
vulture: Ross explained that a vulture eats what's left over, and Joey said that was a tough job.
wacko: Chandler called the weird neighbor a wacko, then realized the neighbor was his friend.
wadding: Joey stuffed wadding into his jacket to look more muscular for a tiny movie role.
waddle: Phoebe did a little waddle to imitate a duck and made everyone at Central Perk laugh.
wag: Phoebe said her dog would wag its tail every time she played guitar, even badly.
wallaby: Ross explained that a wallaby is basically a small kangaroo, and Phoebe wanted one.
walrus: Ross said a walrus has tusks and whiskers, and Joey thought it looked like a grumpy uncle.
warrior: Joey auditioned as a warrior in a period piece and practiced a very intense battle cry.
warship: Ross pointed at a warship in a photo and started explaining its entire history.
wasteland: Chandler called Joey's side of the apartment a wasteland of old pizza boxes.
weeny: Joey complained that his sandwich was weeny and immediately ordered two more.

wellness: Monica insisted on everyone's wellness by making a healthy dinner nobody wanted.
wharf: Phoebe said she once sat on a wharf and sang to the boats as they passed.
whiplash: Joey faked a whiplash injury after a fake car scene and committed way too hard.
whisker: Ross found a whisker in his soup and immediately lost his appetite entirely.
wholistically: Phoebe said she liked to approach life wholistically, which meant hugging trees and singing.
whoopee: Joey shouted whoopee after landing a tiny part and nearly knocked over the coffee table.
whupping: Chandler said Monica gave him a whupping at chess and he wanted a rematch.
widespread: There was widespread panic in the apartment when the coffee ran out.
wield: Joey tried to wield a prop sword in his play and nearly knocked over the set.
wild boar: Ross excitedly explained the difference between a wild boar and a pig to a bored Joey.
wilderness: Phoebe said she once lived in the wilderness and wrote her best songs out there.
winch: Joey used a winch to try to move the couch and ended up moving nothing at all.
windbreaker: Chandler wore a windbreaker to look sporty, then sat on the couch all day anyway.
winding: Ross described the winding path of a river, and Joey started to drift off.
wipeout: Joey tried to surf once and had a total wipeout, which he still bragged about.
woe: Phoebe sang a song of woe about a lost cat and made everyone at Central Perk tear up.
woodchuck: Ross made a tongue twister about a woodchuck and got hopelessly tangled in it.
wool: Monica insisted on wool blankets because they were warm and, more importantly, tidy.
workforce: Chandler joked that the apartment's entire workforce was Monica, and Joey did nothing.
wormy: Joey refused to eat the wormy apple and tossed it straight into the trash.
wounded: Joey acted wounded when Monica criticized his singing, then kept singing anyway.
wrench: Chandler grabbed a wrench to fix the sink and somehow made it worse.
wriggle: Joey tried to wriggle out of doing chores and Monica caught him immediately.
wrongdoing: Chandler was sure Joey's wrongdoing would be discovered the moment Monica checked the fridge.
yapping: Monica told Joey to stop yapping and actually help with dinner for once.
yearn: Phoebe said she would yearn for Central Perk's coffee even if she moved far away.
yelp: Joey let out a yelp when he stubbed his toe on the couch at Monkey's old spot.
zag: Joey said his career seemed to zig and zag with no warning whatsoever.
zap: Chandler tried to zap a bug with a gadget and accidentally zapped himself instead.
zebra: Ross explained that every zebra has a unique pattern, which Joey found fascinating.
zestiness: Phoebe said her zestiness came from singing Smelly Cat every single morning.
zombie: Joey shuffled around like a zombie the morning after eating an entire Thanksgiving dinner.
